items.title: Call to Order
notes: Regional Chair K. Redman called the meeting to order at 1:00 p.m.

items.title: Land Acknowledgement
notes:
Regional Chair K. Redman provided a land acknowledgement.

Bruce Lauckner, Chief Administrative Officer, provided an introduction to the strategic planning process and the current context in Waterloo Region.

items.title: Motion to go into Closed Session
Motion to Reconvene into Open Session
Declarations of Pecuniary Interest under the “Municipal Conflict of Interest Act”
Strategic Planning Workshop
notes:
Connie MacDonald introduced Heather Russek, Creative Futures, and Jessica Thornton, Creative Futures, to lead Council through a conversation on key issues for priority setting for the Region. 

Council discussed and deliberated strategic priorities for the 2023-2027 strategic plan, noting strategic foresight and short and long term priorities as important focus areas.
